correctness.rationale: PASS: for centrally symmetric n-point multiset and positive a0,a1,a2,eta, the even feature z_i=P2(x_i) is orthogonal to odd x. Two Sherman-Morrison inversions show every weight sign is eta-a2 d_i, d_i=z_i sum z_j-sum z_j². For each paired noncentral feature s, s(t-s)=t²/4-(s-t/2)²<=t²/4; the reflected partner contributes zero, and odd n has one central z=-1/2. The resulting maximum is C_n=(n-2)/4 even and max((n-1)/16,(n-6)/4) odd, with explicit realizations incl n=2. PSD matrix order yields Q_eta(1)<=a0 n/(eta+a0 n); C_n/n->1/4 implies universal unmodified bias lower bound a2/(4a0+a2). Independent rational finite grid across n=2..10 confirmed sharp maxima, not substituted for all-n proof.
